text:
ben: Heads-up — customer acme-inc is getting 400s from /v1/tool/invoke. Error: "ValidationError: additionalProperties \u0027session\u0027 is not allowed". trace_id=0a1b2c. Happening after they upgraded our SDK to 2.3.1

maria: Can you paste the request body & a minimal repro? Is this on hosted or dedicated?

ben: Hosted. Posting the request body they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "charge-calculator",
  "args": {
    "amount": 1200,
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "session": "acct-session-xyz",           // <-- extra field
  "billing_profile": null                        // customer expects null allowed
}
```

support-bot: 400 ValidationError: additionalProperties: session at /body/invoke (request_id=0a1b2c)

carla: Thanks — looks like our tool schema for invoke does NOT include "session" and disallows additionalProperties. Two issues here: (1) SDK 2.3.1 started sending session top-level (we used to put it in metadata) and (2) billing_profile being null might violate a non-nullable string type. Can you confirm billing_profile type?

ben: Customer says they upgraded SDK and didn't change their code intentionally. billing_profile previously accepted null. The API contract didn't change in their view.

carla: Ok. Can you capture the raw request body + headers + request_id for a failing call? I want to confirm payload serialization (string vs object). Also need the exact Content-Type. If they send "billing_profile": null and our schema expects string, that'll trigger type mismatch.

ben: Got the request_id 0a1b2c and raw body above. Content-Type: application/json. Minimal repro curl I sent to the customer works for me and reproduces the 400: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"charge-calculator","args":{"amount":1200,"currency":"USD"},"session":"acct-session-xyz","billing_profile":null}'
```

oncall-eng: fyi I saw a spike in similar validation errors from the last deploy window. SDK change might have been the trigger. Suspect schema enforcement in runtime stricter now. Please escalate to eng-runtime if we need a quick compatibility relax.

carla: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- short-term: accept additionalProperties for /tool/invoke (patch in runtime) and coerce null billing_profile -> omit field (or accept null) for 48-72h migration window
- mid-term: update SDK to send "session" under "metadata.session" and make billing_profile nullable in schema, then roll out stricter validation after 2 weeks

maria: Can you open an internal ticket with severity=P1? Customer is blocked in production. Attach trace_id and repro. I'll coordinate with the account team for messaging.

carla: Opening ENG-RT-1243 now with logs and repro. Assigning to @eng-runtime and tagging @oncall-eng. Patch candidate: allowAdditional: true for /v1/tool/invoke request body schema. I'll attach test and rollback plan.

ben: Customer is requesting ETA and short-term workaround. Can we recommend they downgrade SDK to 2.2.x as temporary fix?

carla: Yes that's safest short-term. I'll also try a hotfix toggle to relax validation for specific routes for customers that opt in. If everyone agrees, we can flip it for the customer within the hour. Need approvals from infra.

oncall-eng: Approve hotfix for this customer only. Make sure we add explicit telemetry so we can revert if any unexpected behavior.

ben: Sent the downgrade steps to the customer and asked if they'd like us to flip the hotfix. They're open to it.

maria: Thanks team. Follow-up action items: (1) carla — keep ENG-RT-1243 updated and post rollback plan; (2) ben — coordinate with the customer on downgrade/hotfix; (3) carla/oncall-eng — add migration notes to release docs so SDK users know the new placement for session and billing_profile nullability.

carla: Will do. Also adding an improved error message to the runtime so we return: "Validation failed: unknown top-level field \u0027session\u0027 — expected fields are [tool,args,metadata] — please move session to metadata or use SDK v2.2.x"

ben: Perfect, that should reduce tickets. Thanks :thumbsup:

maria: Closing the loop with the account now.
